findings.problem: The example leaves guardar as an infinitive after puedes, but the target verb must be conjugated.
findings.fix: example.es: Siempre guardo las llaves en el cajón. / example.en: I always keep the keys in the drawer.

back.es: to keep, to put away, to store, to save (a file, a seat)

note: The hint is needed because otherwise "to keep" could also mean mantener, conservar or quedarse con, and "put away, store" points clearly to guardar.
